risk_note: Taobao resolveLink, first step, plus the Taobao shop type (D10-2674 ②, D10-2683, D10-2695). resolveLink now recognises only https item.taobao.com / detail.tmall.com /item.htm with a 1-20 digit id (host lowercased without trailing dot, no port, no user info, path exact); it sends one taobao.tbk.item.info.upgrade.get and returns the item_id of this answer (never the id cache that dataoke search fills, BR-PROD-05); an empty answer, 15/50001 or a row without a non-empty string item_id is link_unrecognized; other upstream errors keep their class. Every other input (promotion links, m.tb.cn, mobile pages, tokens) still throws adapter_unimplemented before credentials or transport ([AC-B1-04j#30] stays green). The Taobao detail mapping reads user_type (0 -> taobao, 1 -> tmall, anything else -> absent; docs-mirror taobao.tbk.item.info.upgrade.get.md:125) into an optional shop_type on the item detail, and parsing's ProductRef.shopType takes it (null when absent; jd / pdd unchanged). No conversion, order, contract or money code touched.
